slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
【阅读指南：本文古早风，借读者的评论就是有一种十几年前网文的美，成长型男主，介意误入，感谢支持】
乌云遮天，天边隐约传来滚滚雷声，偶尔可见粗如巨蟒的雷光在云层中狂舞。
下方的密林中，一头巨狼正在飞速的奔跑，仔细看，它的背上还驮着一个人。
那人浑身浴血，披头散发，破碎的衣服底下隐约可以看到一道道皮肉翻卷的狰狞伤口。
但即便身受重伤，他身姿却依旧挺拔，牢牢的护着怀中的襁褓。
襁褓已经不知道被男人的血还是别人的血浸的湿透，婴儿的小脸露出来一小半，红扑扑的，睡的正香。
男人低头亲了亲婴儿的额头，“我的儿子，我对不起你的母亲，也对不起你。”
巨狼突然停住脚步，前方已经没有树了，而是高达百米的断崖，断崖下是汹涌的罗刹海，万灵大陆的四大禁地之一。
“灵主，前面没有路了。”
身后汹涌的雷光在不断的逼近，男人的眼中满是决绝。
他从巨狼的背上翻身而下，搂住巨狼的脖子和它拥抱了一下。
“霜月，我儿子就拜托你了。”
巨狼蓝色的大眼睛里满是忧伤，它知道男人要做什么，这是现在他们唯一的选择。
它垂下头，前肢曲起行了一个礼，“誓死保护少主。”
男人将襁褓用灵力缚在巨狼的胸前，一把扯掉了上身的衣服。
他的胸前是一个武威霸气的巨狼兽纹，分明是眼前叫做霜月的巨狼的模样。
随着他的动作，一个巨大的繁复的银色法阵在他们的脚底张开。
男人将手摁在巨狼的头上，嘶吼着喊道：“解契！”
银色法阵剧烈震颤起来，最终猛然碎裂，化作点点银光消散。
男人猛的吐出一口鲜血，胸口的兽纹被几道深可见骨的伤口取代。

巨狼双目含泪：“灵主！”
男人取出一把长枪反手撑在地上，支撑住摇摇欲坠的身体。
抹了一把唇角的血对巨狼道：“快走！”
天空中的雷光已经近在眼前，隐隐能够听到狮吼鹰唳的声音。
巨狼深深看了男人一眼，带着襁褓，从悬崖上一跃而下。
它的脚底下浮现出一片片阶梯状的冰纹，到达海面上后，凝聚出一条冰路朝着罗刹海的深处跑去。
男人看着它的身影跑远，将长枪拔了出来，转身面对步步紧逼的追兵。
漆黑的云层被破开，全部由五阶以上的灵主组成的雷鹫大军朝着男人俯冲而下，雷光将天地间映成了一片雪白。
男人吐出一口血沫，手中长枪一甩，“就让你们看看什么叫做半圣！”
满背的蟒纹在他身上蜿蜒游动，一个方圆千米的金色法阵在半空中浮现，生生把雷鹫军团的银色雷光压了下去。
一条长达百米的雷纹翻天蟒从阵纹中一跃而出，张口便将冲在最前面的十几只雷鹫吞了进去。
“九阶，他的本命灵宠竟然突破到九阶了！”
阳光被茂盛的枝叶遮蔽，只有很少一部分能透过树叶的间隙照耀下来，在铺满厚厚落叶的地上投下一片片光斑。
树冠下方的灌木丛中发出哗啦哗啦的迅疾响声，树林中似乎有什么东西在快速移动。
半人高的草丛被豁然分开，一个身量高瘦的少年从中一跃而出，飞速朝着前方跑去，他的身后，似乎有什么东西在追赶着。
“咔嚓”
一声巨响，一棵大树被撞断，一个庞大的黑影紧追着少年从树林中跑了出来。
这是一头成年雄性野猪，膘肥体壮，至少有四五百斤重，黝黑发亮的鬃毛浓密厚实，突出嘴唇的獠牙足有小臂长，一看就很不好惹。
挡路的树木全部被生生撞断，野猪猩红的小眼睛死死盯着前方奔跑的少年，誓要将这个胆敢挑衅它的人类撞死。
少年跑的极快，身法也极灵活，在树林间辗转腾挪，野猪的每一次冲撞都能恰到好处的避开，神情间一点儿也不见慌乱。

Dark clouds cover the sky, and there is a faint sound of rolling thunder from the horizon. Occasionally, lightning as thick as a giant python can be seen dancing wildly in the clouds.
In the dense forest below, a giant wolf was running rapidly. If you look carefully, you can see that it is carrying a person on its back.
The man was covered in blood and his hair was disheveled. Under the torn clothes, you could vaguely see the hideous wounds on his skin.
But even though he was seriously injured, he remained tall and straight, firmly protecting the baby in his arms.
The swaddling clothes were already soaked with the man's blood or someone else's blood. Only half of the baby's face was exposed. It was flushed and sleeping soundly.
The man lowered his head and kissed the baby's forehead, "My son, I'm sorry for your mother, and I'm sorry for you."
The giant wolf suddenly stopped. There were no trees in front of it, but a cliff hundreds of meters high. Under the cliff was the turbulent Rakshasa Sea, one of the four forbidden areas in Wanling Continent.
"Spirit Master, there is no way ahead."
The surging lightning behind him kept approaching, and the man's eyes were full of determination.
He rolled off the giant wolf's back, put his arms around the giant wolf's neck and hugged it.
"Shuangyue, I leave my son to you."
The giant wolf's big blue eyes were full of sadness. It knew what the men were going to do. This was their only choice now.
It lowered its head and bent its forelimbs in a salute, "Swear to protect the young master to the death."
The man tied the swaddling clothes to the giant wolf's chest with spiritual power and tore off the clothes on his upper body.
On his chest was a mighty and domineering giant wolf pattern, which clearly looked like the giant wolf in front of him called Shuangyue.
Following his movements, a huge and complicated silver magic circle opened under their feet.
The man put his hand on the giant wolf's head and roared: "Dissolve the contract!"
The silver magic circle trembled violently, and finally shattered suddenly, turning into little bits of silver light and dissipating.
The man spat out a mouthful of blood, and the animal patterns on his chest were replaced by several wounds that were deep enough to show the bones.
The giant wolf had tears in his eyes: "Spirit Master!"
The man took out a long gun and put it on the ground with his backhand to support his shaky body.
Wiping a handful of blood from the corner of his lips, he said to the giant wolf: "Quickly go!"
The lightning in the sky was already close before our eyes, and we could faintly hear the roar of lions and the chirping of eagles.
The giant wolf took a deep look at the man, then jumped off the cliff with the baby in his arms.
Pieces of step-like ice patterns appeared under its feet. After reaching the surface of the sea, it formed an ice road and ran towards the depths of the Rakshasa Sea.
The man watched its figure run away, pulled out his spear, and turned to face the pursuing soldiers.
The dark clouds were broken, and the army of thunder vultures, all composed of spiritual masters of the fifth level and above, swooped down towards the man. The thunder light reflected the sky and the earth into a snowy white.
The man spat out a mouthful of blood and flicked the spear in his hand, "I'll show you what it means to be a half-saint!"
The python patterns on his back were winding and swimming on his body, and a golden magic circle with a radius of one kilometer emerged in mid-air, suppressing the silver lightning of the Thunder Vulture Legion.
A hundred-meter-long thunder-patterned sky-turning python jumped out of the formation, opened its mouth and swallowed the dozen thunder vultures rushing in front.
"Ninth level, his natal spiritual pet has actually broken through to the ninth level!"
The sunlight is blocked by the lush branches and leaves, and only a small part can shine through the gaps between the leaves, casting patches of light on the ground covered with thick fallen leaves.
There was a rapid rushing sound in the bushes below the canopy, and something seemed to be moving quickly in the woods.
The grass half a man tall was suddenly parted, and a tall and thin boy jumped out and ran forward quickly. Behind him, something seemed to be chasing him.
"Click"
There was a loud noise, a big tree was broken, and a huge black figure ran after the young man from the woods.come out.
This is an adult male wild boar, fat and strong, weighing at least four to five hundred kilograms. It has thick, dark and shiny manes, and the tusks protruding from its lips are as long as a forearm. It is very difficult to mess with at first glance.
All the trees blocking the road were broken. The wild boar's small scarlet eyes stared at the young man running ahead, vowing to kill this human who dared to provoke it.
The young man ran extremely fast and his movements were extremely flexible. He moved around in the woods and avoided every collision of the wild boar without any panic in his expression.
